definitions.supplemental: Cf. Mid. E. ding to throw oneself with force, dash, press, drive.
definitions.meaning: to press, throw oneself with force

source_text: ge-dingan (?) to press, throw oneself with force :-- Gedinð appetit, Kent. Gl. 1155. [Cf. Mid. E. ding to throw oneself with force, dash, press, drive.]
